$schema-comment: Configuration for the Mkpong orthography-aware logo system. scripts/outline-glyphs.mjs and scripts/build-logo.mjs both read this file; the runtime embeds it at build time.

font.why: Gelasio is metric-compatible with Georgia, the font the original hand-made SVG asked for, and it is OFL so it can ship with the site.

palette.$comment: PROVISIONAL Akwa Ibom palette carried over from the original hand-made SVG. Centralised here and emitted as CSS variables so values can change in one place. See logo/TODO.md.

color.$comment: Spec palette, exactly as the original artwork.

mono.$comment: One ink colour. The front M is knocked out to the page background (--mkpong-bg) and stroked, otherwise the three Ms merge into a blob.

literal.$comment: Used for static exports, which cannot use currentColor or custom properties.

dark.$comment: Lifted greens/oranges and a light wordmark so the mark and the white M's outline stay legible on a dark page.

mark.$comment: Canonical geometry. Offsets are relative to the cluster centre-x and reproduce the hand-aligned original: centres 310/400/490 at font-size 300 with the centre-x at 400. The cluster never changes with orthography.
mark.$strokeWidth: user units (px on the 300px mark); only the front/white M is stroked, with the outline colour.

wordmark.$comment: text is the letter sequence; O and N are replaced by the selected variants. Offsets are laid out from advance widths + the kerning table, then the whole word is centred on its true ink bounding box (never CSS letter-spacing, which leaves a trailing offset).
wordmark.$kerning: Pair kerning in font units (M,K,P,O,N,G and each variant key). Empty = no kerning. See logo/TODO.md: Gelasio has no legacy 'kern' table and opentype.js does not read GPOS, so real kerning still has to be supplied by hand.

orthography.$comment: The ONLY letters that change. 'g' = which wordmark slot the glyph fills. 'char' is the exact codepoint in Gelasio. Anything ambiguous is needsReview:true and is listed in logo/TODO.md.

o_dot.label: Ọ — O with dot below
o_dot.note: Precomposed uppercase O with dot below, present in Gelasio.

o_open.label: Ɔ — open O
o_open.note: LATIN CAPITAL LETTER OPEN O, present in Gelasio. Mirrored-C construction is available as a fallback (see composeFallback) if this ever has to be drawn instead.

n_hook.label: Ŋ — n with hook (PROVISIONAL)
n_hook.note: AMBIGUOUS. Gelasio has both U+014A LATIN CAPITAL LETTER ENG (Ŋ, right/descender hook) and U+019D LATIN CAPITAL LETTER N WITH LEFT HOOK (Ɲ). Ŋ is used by default. Confirm which hook, and which side. See logo/TODO.md.

n_tilde.label: Ñ — n with tilde
n_tilde.note: Precomposed LATIN CAPITAL LETTER N WITH TILDE, present in Gelasio.

n_bar.label: Ṉ — n with bar (PROVISIONAL)
n_bar.note: AMBIGUOUS. Defaults to U+1E48 LATIN CAPITAL LETTER N WITH MACRON BELOW (Ṉ, a bar under the N) because Gelasio has no precomposed 'N with stroke'. Other readings are N + combining macron below, or a bar through the N (needs a composed glyph). Confirm. See logo/TODO.md.

composeFallback.$comment: Used ONLY when a variant's codepoint is missing from the font. No variant currently needs it; the mechanism is implemented and exercised by scripts/check-logo.mjs. Adding geometry here is a design decision, not a linguistic one, so nothing is invented for Mkpong.

mirrorOpenO.$comment: open O drawn as a horizontally mirrored C.

layouts.$comment: gap is the pixel spacing between the two units (vertical for stacked, horizontal for inline).

backgrounds.$comment: Only used for the dark-theme static exports and the demo checkerboard.

exports.$comment: Drives scripts/build-logo.mjs. Trim lists here to export less.

favicon.$comment: Mark-only and orthography-independent, so it never changes with the user's preference.
favicon.$simplification: The favicon is the mark only (no wordmark). The mark is ~2.2:1, so in a square icon it is letterboxed: see logo/TODO.md for the open question about a tighter small-size mark.
